name: ellines-eip
description: Ellines EIP (Enterprise Intelligence Platform) — Where Enterprise Systems Think Together

scripts.dev: node scripts/free-ports.mjs 3100 3001 && concurrently -n shared,sdk,identity,web -c gray,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @ellines-eip/shared" "npm run dev -w @ellines-eip/connectors-sdk" "npm run dev -w @ellines-eip/identity" "npm run dev -w @ellines-eip/web"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @ellines-eip/shared && npm run build -w @ellines-eip/connectors-sdk && npm run build -w @ellines-eip/ellinea-ai && npm run build -w @ellines-eip/ellinea-sdk
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ellines-eip/web
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run verify:pages-functions && npm run build:web && npm run deploy:pages -w @ellines-eip/web
scripts.seed:local: npm run db:local && npm run seed:demo && npm run db:cloud
